# Zenith

Zenith is a high-contrast theme for the Obsidian desktop application, built with modular SCSS and described as focusing on visual depth, typography and smooth transitions. Its recorded description names floating capsule tabs, a spectrum-based colour hierarchy for headings and subtle glassmorphic glow panels, alongside a Parchment light mode and an IDE Deep Blue dark mode. It also states that Zenith is intended as the visual anchor for the Mantle plugins, covering calendar, kanban boards, document viewers and AI interfaces.

![Zenith screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carnalmatrix/obsidian-mantle-zenith/HEAD/screenshot.png)

Built with modular SCSS, it focuses on visual depth, typography, and smooth transitions to create an immersive IDE-like workspace. Key features include floating \"capsule\" tabs for clean navigation, a spectrum-based colour hierarchy for headings to make scanning notes effortless, and subtle glassmorphic glow panels. Zenith is optimised to serve as the visual anchor for all Mantle plugins, ensuring a cohesive design across your calendar, kanban boards, document viewers, and AI interfaces. Supports a subtle Parchment light mode and an IDE Deep Blue dark mode."
